An engine fix would need a new engine file and a refit of E's table.

large_latency_system.pool: W, r3_X_regtrkdk_v1, r3_X_regtrkstsafe_v1, every round-4 variant
large_latency_system.K1: mean rt_nd_live over {micbt_cal, bt_cal} x {sung, sung_low} >= W's + 0.005
large_latency_system.K2: in each of those 4 cells: harsh <= W's + 0.003, fresh_per100 <= W's + 0.5, stumbles_per100 <= W's + 1.0
large_latency_system.K3: v11 at its native latency: fresh_heard <= 4 and harsh_heard <= 0.1602 (round-3 G3)
large_latency_system.K4: bench_rt at L = 0.5 vs reactive:r2_mix_v2 at L = 0.5: rt_nd >= reactive + 0.005, harsh <= reactive, fresh clashes per 100 <= reactive, seed2 delta >= +0.003
large_latency_system.rank: highest K1 mean; within 0.003, fewer fresh + stumbles summed over the 4 cells
large_latency_system.use: if the pick also passes round-3 G1/G2/G3 at wired and its wired mean (sung, sung_low) >= W's - 0.003, it replaces W as the single default; otherwise the page uses it only when the calibrated round trip is >= 120 ms and W below that. If nothing passes, W everywhere.
